# ZDI Advisories

Zero Day Initiative advisory archive with static data files for LLM and agent use.

- Skill: /skill.md
- Schema: /schema.json
- Index: /data/index.json
- Published: /data/published.json
- Upcoming: /data/upcoming.json
- Stats: /data/stats.json
- Advisory detail: /data/advisories/<zdi_id>/advisory.json
- Advisory Markdown: /data/advisories/<zdi_id>/advisory.md
